bluestsdk_v2.changelog: 0.2.0: ESKF attitude filter, on-board mag/accel calibration, PFD stream 60 Hz, panel profile stored on the instrument (units/thresholds adopted by any display), battery caution+alarm levels, zero-loss BLE acquisition, SD file transfer to the app (BLE file channel), selectable gyro range 1000/2000 dps, LED colour code + buzzer signalling; 2026-11-19: no double arithmetic left in the filter, the calibrations, the clock or the printing, the GNSS height on the modem's EGM96 geoid, the stale BLE link to the GNSS modem handled, BLE command retries 0, the PnP-Like layer removed

characteristics.name: Sensor Fusion quaternion (ESKF attitude, the app's 3D cube; qi/qj/qk/qw as float32)
SD file channel (sd get/put payload: chunks, credits, CRC32)

format_notify.name: qx x 10000 (qw >= 0, carried at the frame tail)
Flags (b0 ESKF run, b1 mag fresh, b2 baro ok, b3 QNH set, b4 sustained turn, b5 stationary, b6 accel clipping)
qw x 10000 (reconstruction near |qw| = 0 is ill-conditioned, so qw travels)
